title: Anchorage Golf Course
specs: Public championship golf course with 18 holes
Longest tee times up to 10:00pm due to Alaska daylight
Children must be 6 years or older to be on the golf course for playing or watching
Proper attire required: golf appropriate shirts or t-shirts, jeans allowed, no profane or graphic attire, shirts and shorts must be appropriate length
Event rooms available for 15 to 170 people, cocktail receptions up to 250

blurb: Guests play golf on an 18-hole public championship course with options for 9 holes or twilight play. Lessons and clinics are available for all skill levels and ages, including junior golf programs. The facility also offers event and meeting spaces with catering services.
tags: Group Lessons - Get Golf Ready Program
extraNote: All golf players must register at the Pro Shop prior to playing · No five-somes allowed · Reservations encouraged; single golfers can join wait list · Cancellation less than 5 days in advance may be charged if tee time cannot be filled · Bringing own alcoholic beverages and coolers not permitted · Carts must be kept at least 30 yards from greens; 90-degree rule applies · Pro Shop at Anchorage Golf Course · April to October depending on weather and conditions, peak June to early September
